notes: Accepted transport-level differences for HTTP /call versus Nostr control RPC. These are envelope and routing differences, not method-semantic differences.

accepted_deviations.reason: HTTP /call uses HTTP status codes and wraps method payloads in { ok, result, error }.
Nostr control uses signed request/result events, requester pubkeys, req correlation IDs, and relay routing outside the JSON method payload.
ACP-over-FIPS preserves the same ACP {acp_type: task|result} envelope and semantics; only the encrypted DM transport differs from NIP-17/NIP-04 delivery.
swarmstr consumes the FIPS daemon as a sidecar and tracks its control-socket and observability read surface; swarmstr does not reimplement FIPS protocol internals.
The [u32 len][u8 type][JSON] framing used by swarmstr is swarmstr application framing carried over fips0, not the canonical FMP/FSP wire format owned by the FIPS daemon.
Daemon-owned settings such as transports.nym, node.discovery.lan.*, Nostr discovery kinds 37195/21059/10050, and bloom max_inbound_fpr live in the FIPS daemon configuration, not in swarmstr.
